narrative.overview: A lectern is where a department speaks with authority and without raising its voice. Deep navy sets the institutional tone, gold appears only where something is being certified, announced or offered, and real content does the persuading. Surfaces are flat and tonal.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-led, gold as a seal: the accent is rare on purpose.
Flat and tonal elevation; depth through color blocks and hairline borders.
One body family (Inter), one display voice (Poppins), strong weight contrast.
Light and dark themes; layouts survive Spanish and English copy at mobile width.
WCAG AA is the floor, not a goal.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Mine Gold marks one thing at a time: the primary invitation or the active state.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: There is a single brand blue, Midnight Institute. The stock shadcn blue behind --primary is drift and must be replaced.

rules.name: The Gold-On-Navy Rule
rules.body: Gold sits on navy; text on a gold fill is navy, never white.

rules.name: The Heading Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings are Poppins, everything else is Inter. No third family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If a card needs a shadow to be seen, its border or background is wrong.

dos: Do let Midnight Institute (#001b55) carry hero, footer and primary actions, and use Mine Gold (#d79b05) as a rare seal.
Do put navy text on gold fills and gold or white text on navy surfaces; check every pair for AA.
Do keep layouts intact at 360px width and in both Spanish and English strings.
donts: Don't build a generic university portal: no stock-photo banners, carousels, logo walls or bureaucratic copy.
Don't build a SaaS/startup template: no gradients, no identical icon-and-heading cards, no hero metrics.
Don't use hacker clichés: no green terminal text, neon accents or Matrix effects.
Don't use white text on a gold fill (2.4:1).
